about: How every Edge CMS site launches. A person reads it as a checklist; the edge-site-launch skill works from it in three stages (pre-launch on the draft site, launch steps for a person, post-launch on the live domain). `check.readiness` items pass when the readiness report lacks those codes; `check.results` items pass when the run records { ok: true, evidence } for them (results.json). Evaluate with edge-site-setup's scripts/standards-report.mjs --standards launch-standards.json --readiness readiness.json --results results.json.

items.rule: Every site setup standard passes (edge-site-setup site-standards.json), except the placeholder domain.
Every page has a unique meta title (about 30-60 characters) and meta description (about 70-160), valid structured data with the right tokens.
items.how: readiness, then compare lengths and duplicates across pages (cms_list_pages, cms_get_page)

items.rule: Every page has exactly one h1, and every content image has alt text.
items.how: chrome-devtools: open each preview link, evaluate_script for h1 count and img[alt] (or lighthouse_audit accessibility)

items.rule: Every internal and external link on every page resolves.
Every form routes to the right recipient.
items.how: readiness, the routing table (form, emailTo or site contact email), and a form test per form once the renderer forwards formTest

items.rule: Every page works at phone width: no horizontal scroll, readable text, tap targets large enough.
items.how: cms_preview_url viewport mobile, chrome-devtools emulate or resize_page 390x844, evaluate_script scrollWidth vs innerWidth

items.rule: No image is linked from outside the Hub's media.
Every override block has its component deployed in the public renderer.
No block errors, missing blocks or unreleased drafts the site needs.
Replace the placeholder .test domain with the real domain in the Hub's site settings (Domains), set the canonical domain and apex forwarding, and publish the site settings.
Point DNS at the site in Cloudflare (the records the Hub's domain status shows) and wait until the domain status is connected.
Release any block drafts the site uses, then publish every page and the site settings in the Hub.
Create or link the site's Google Analytics property and set its measurement id in the site settings when it wasn't set at setup.
Set the site up in MyStats through the Claude session that works in the EdgeMyStats project. The launch report records whether it was done; the skill does not check it.
The domain serves the site over HTTPS, http and the apex (or www) forward to the canonical host.
robots.txt allows the site and names the sitemap; the sitemap lists the site's pages on the canonical host.
Google Analytics receives hits from the live site.
items.how: analytics MCP run_realtime_report for the property, after opening the site

items.rule: Lighthouse on the key pages, mobile and desktop: performance, accessibility, best practices and SEO, with the failing audits listed.
items.how: chrome-devtools lighthouse_audit (accessibility, best practices, SEO) and performance_start_trace or npx lighthouse@13.6.0 for performance

items.rule: Real-user Core Web Vitals from PageSpeed Insights once the site has traffic (none is fine for a new site; say so).
Links and forms work again on the live site.
A launch report is kept with the site's project files, so a later re-check can compare.
